headline: Both layers are in place. The work is completeness and correctness, not adoption.

recommendations.title: Checkout: one rename, not new instrumentation
recommendations.why: expected `checkout.payment.authorize`, found `checkout.payment_authorize`. The step is already emitting; every query against the bound name returns empty.
recommendations.ask: Rename the span. Cheapest fix in the whole engagement.

recommendations.title: Checkout: funnel goes dark at payment_authorized
recommendations.why: Drop-off from these steps is being attributed to the last instrumented step, so the owning team never sees it.
recommendations.ask: Instrument the missing steps before adding any new journey.

recommendations.title: Checkout: outcome is a string enum, not a boolean
recommendations.why: Sentry renders boolean attributes as the strings 'true'/'false', and a binary collapses failed, abandoned, and rejected into one bucket. Those three route to three different teams.

recommendations.title: Checkout: magnitude `cart.value` is numeric
recommendations.why: A value stringified as "129.99" cannot be aggregated — sum() and p50() silently return nothing useful. The instrumentation looks correct and produces no answer.
recommendations.ask: `cart.value` is type `string`, expected `number` — fix the type.

recommendations.title: Declared journeys whose correlation key already exists
recommendations.why: The correlation key is present for: Subscription Upgrade. Only the spans are missing.
recommendations.ask: Sequence these next — they are the shortest path to a working funnel.
